name: comp-312

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the whole strip and the Update now button at rest, with the cursor below it.

tagline: Thin bar offers a new version with an Update now button that spins.
summary: A slim centred bar showing a version number and release line beside an outlined Update now button, which becomes a spinner and Updating label while it pretends to work.
appearance: A full-width muted grey band, a little lighter than the page, with its contents centred on one line. Small text reads v2.1.0, a dot, then a release note, followed by a small outlined Update now button with a download arrow.
behaviour: Pressing Update now disables the button, swaps its label for Updating... and shows a spinning loader; after about two seconds it returns to normal.
demo_content: v2.1.0 • New features and improvements available
use_when: A new release is out and you want a low-key strip with one update action.
avoid_when: The download is simulated, so it only changes the button for two seconds and installs nothing.
customise: Version, message and button labels are hardcoded, and the download is a fixed two-second timeout.
weight_why: One thin bar; the only script work is a short timeout and a spinning icon.

a11y.note: Button text names the action and both icons are hidden, but the spinner keeps turning with no reduced-motion check.

issues: Update is faked with a timeout and installs nothing.
polish_why: Neat centred strip with a clear loading state; plain and stock otherwise.
title: Version Update Banner
